description: Send a plain-text email from a connected mailbox (a copy is saved in its Sent folder; up to 20 recipients, 100,000 characters). Up to 5 attachments (15 MB in total: PDF, images, documents, zip): either a file from customer storage (service_id, region, bucket, key; any size up to 10 MB) or a small file as content_base64 (up to 700 KB). To reply, pass the message-id of the email in reply_to_message_id. Needs confirm: true after the customer approves the exact recipients, subject and text.

content_base64.description: The file itself, base64 (small files only).

filename.description: Name shown to the recipient (defaults to the storage file name).

key.description: Storage file to attach instead of content_base64.

service_id.description: Object Storage service id (for a storage file).

confirm.description: Must be true. Set it only after the customer has explicitly confirmed this exact change.

email.description: Mailbox address on one of the customer's own domains, e.g. info@example.com.

name: mail_send
title: Send an email
